item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00189","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C14","C12","C21"],"selected_candidate_label":"C14","confidence":0.91,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C14 plausibly supplied a material template because it establishes the same career-executive initiative and assigns closely corresponding machinery to the Civil Service Commission: developing executive training programs, assisting executive agencies, recommending steps to strengthen the program, and reporting progress to the President. The child recasts that machinery as instructions to the Commission after leadership responsibility was placed with the Special Assistant for Personnel Management. C12 and C21 strongly explain that consultative relationship, but C14 supplies the more distinctive substantive program being administered.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"selection and development of highly competent career administrators","parent_excerpt":"identification, selection, placement, and retention of civil-service career executives","explanation":"Both directives address the selection and development of high-level career administrators, using closely parallel program language."},{"child_excerpt":"the Commission will continue to provide assistance to the departments and agencies in strengthening their executive development programs","parent_excerpt":"Assist the Commission and the heads of the several executive agencies in the development of effective programs for the training of career civil-service employees for promotion to positions in the career executive service and for the training of career executives.","explanation":"The child continues the same Commission-and-agency machinery for developing and training career executives."},{"child_excerpt":"take whatever steps may be necessary to strengthen them and to achieve maximum coordination","parent_excerpt":"Recommend to the President and to the Commission such steps as will strengthen the career executive program.","explanation":"This is a close substantive and linguistic correspondence concerning steps to strengthen the career-executive program."},{"child_excerpt":"the Commission will assemble periodically and report to me, information summarizing significant developments and progress","parent_excerpt":"The Board shall submit an annual report of its activities to the President through the Commission.","explanation":"Both provide a reporting channel through the Commission to keep the President informed about implementation of the career-executive program."}]}
